answer_1.quote: We evaluate the proposed Look‑back decoding on two open‑ended generation tasks: document continuation on WikiText‑103 and story generation on WritingPrompts.
answer_1.outputs: Generated continuations (256‑token sequences) for each prefix

answer_2.quote: We report automatic metrics including rep‑n (repetition), MAUVE, and cosine similarity between prefix and continuation embeddings (SimCSE) to assess coherence.

answer_4.quote: Human evaluation was performed by three annotators who were asked to compare Look‑back and SimCTG outputs on fluency and coherence, choosing which continuation was better or if they were tied.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rated each pair of generations on two criteria: fluency and coherence, selecting the better continuation or indicating a tie.
